tests.name: queue-order
tests.says: The queue returns the member with the oldest waiting hold first.

tests.name: one-open-hold
tests.says: The partial unique index refuses a second open hold by the same member.

tests.name: opening-days
tests.says: Three opening days skip the days the branch is closed.

tests.name: place-hold
tests.says: POST /holds answers 201 with the place in line, 409 for a second hold, and 422 when a copy is on the shelf.

tests.name: shelve-on-return
tests.says: A desk return shelves the copy for the first member and prints a slip with their name.

tests.name: night-run
tests.says: The night run passes a copy on after three opening days.

tests.name: cancel-on-shelf
tests.says: Cancelling a hold whose copy is shelved passes the copy to the next member.

tests.name: my-holds
tests.says: A member places a hold from the book page and sees it on My holds.

tests.name: cancel-hold
tests.says: A member cancels a ready hold from its pickup details.

tests.name: ready-email
tests.says: On the staging library, a returned test copy sends the ready email to the test member.
